flags.finding: In scene S020, Stu remarks in dialogue that he once caught himself 'gazing at a topless photo of David Beckham.' flags.finding: In scene S023, the script describes 'Becky in her Laura Ashley bedroom, angrily packing up her suitcase.' Set dressing utilizing ordinary home furnishings or styling in an expressive work does not require a trademark license. No Laura Ashley trademarks need to be prominently featured.

citations.title: Using Trademarks in Film and TV
citations.excerpt: A filmmaker has every right to dress sets with real products, but no right to disparage a trademark. If the movie does not misrepresent the source of the product there is typically no prohibition of the use of a trademark in a film.

remedy.detail: No license required. Art department can dress the bedroom set with generic traditional floral wallpapers and textiles.
